name: teatime
description: TeaTime: one sourced tea blend a weekday, made from your own pantry (SPEC.md).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w content && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run content:check && npm test
scripts.daily:restore: docker compose run --rm --no-deps app node dist/scripts/restore.js
